## Plot and create DF of all transactions

Below runs an R file that does a lot of heavy lifting for plotting your transactions and account summary. Simply define the location of your CSV directory and hit run.

```{r}
# Define your directory here! Example:
dir <- "Aug24-Aug26/"
source("PlotMain.R")
```
